data: Only the existing frozen bilingual and public training rows fit neural weights. Reserve unused public positive TRAIN groups as our own held-out data and unused official-test negative groups before fitting. Disclose positive source partition and narrow volume-only coverage; old sets are observed regressions.
representation: Fixed rich-text-v1 1024 features, five supported labels plus __reject__. No vocabulary updates or test augmentation.
fits: Four fits, widths0/16 x seeds42/97. Stratified language/class round-robin balancing as previous six-class experiment. Mini-batch32 AdamW, lr.003, beta1.9 beta2.999 eps1e-8, decoupled weight decay.0005 on weights only, global gradient-norm clipping1, <=100 epochs, development checks every5, patience15. Xavier uniform initialization and copied best snapshot. Select epoch by development language/class-macro raw accuracy, tie lower NLL.
targets: Label smoothing.02. On old supported training rows where frozen teacher choice equals the true label only, mix smoothed true target equally with the teacher's calibrated five-domain distribution extended with zero reject probability. On all other rows use the true smoothed label only. No distillation of known teacher mistakes or unsupported false choices.
calibration: Each fit selects temperature on calibration-only macro NLL, grid .5/.75/1/1.5/2/3/5.
policy: Teacher is the frozen rich plus conservative public gate. Never upgrade a prior abstention. For each prior domain fit reject and alternative-proposal thresholds separately on development. Descending grid reject1.1/.99/.95/.9/.8/.7/.6/.5, switch1.1/.99/.95/.9/.8/.7/.6 with fixed expert margin>.15. 1.1 explicitly disables the action. Agreeing choices return the original decision. Reject or switch only above the domain threshold; no valid switch to __reject__. Require zero lost prior-correct supported development decisions. Maximize global language/outcome-balanced correct decisions, ties keep more conservative first policy. Skip expert encoding/inference if both domain actions are disabled.
selection: Select among four calibrated models using fitted policy development balanced utility, then smaller parameter count, then lower development NLL. Include frozen teacher as baseline/no-action policy. Export weights/policy before loading fresh rows. No test-based refit or threshold change. The committed prior SGD six-class expert is an eligible fixed control under the same fitted policy and temperature; do not claim AdamW wins if the control is selected.
limits: Learned proposal/refusal only, no tool authorization. Fixed four fits, <=20000 expert parameters. Production eligibility remains false; any individual held-out known-case loss is explicit and prevents promotion.
